Shrink rates towards the group average (empirical Bayes)

Source: R/metrics.R
shrink_rate.Rd

Fits a beta distribution to the observed rates made / attempts across all rows (or within group) by marginal maximum likelihood of the beta-binomial, and returns each row's posterior mean and a credible interval. A player who is 0/2 from three is pulled almost all the way to the average; a player who is 150/400 barely moves. This replaces raw percentages wherever small samples would otherwise dominate a figure (the range of a team's 3P% is otherwise set by a 0/2 shooter).

Usage

shrink_rate(made, attempts, group = NULL, level = 0.8)

Arguments

made, attempts

Counts.

group

Optional grouping vector (e.g. league or zone): a separate prior is fitted per group.

level

Width of the credible interval.

Value

A tibble with raw, shrunk, lower, upper, prior_mean, prior_n (the prior's weight in pseudo-attempts).

Examples

shrink_rate(c(0, 150, 30), c(2, 400, 80))
#> # A tibble: 3 × 8
#>    made attempts   raw shrunk lower upper prior_mean prior_n
#>   <dbl>    <dbl> <dbl>  <dbl> <dbl> <dbl>      <dbl>   <dbl>
#> 1     0        2 0      0.374 0.372 0.375      0.374  100000
#> 2   150      400 0.375  0.374 0.372 0.375      0.374  100000
#> 3    30       80 0.375  0.374 0.372 0.375      0.374  100000
